text: FIX indexed number fields with a `multipleOf` of `0.0000001` or smaller lost their decimals in the index string because the `multipleOf` is printed in exponent notation (`1e-7`), which led to wrong sort order and wrong `$gt`/`$lt` results on storages that use the custom index strings. Data that was stored with such a schema on a persistent storage has to be migrated to a new schema version to rebuild the index.
